segments.name: Digital asset treasury
segments.description: A U.S. publicly listed digital asset treasury company that accumulates HYPE tokens on behalf of its stockholders and pursues income-earning activities in the Hyperliquid ecosystem.
segments.evidence: Our primary business is accumulating HYPE, the native token of the Hyperliquid Layer 1 blockchain ecosystem ("HYPE" or "HYPE Tokens"), on behalf of our stockholders.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company completed mergers with Sonnet BioTherapeutics Holdings, becoming a publicly listed Nasdaq entity under the symbol PURR.
changes.evidence: On December 2, 2025 (the "Closing Date"), we completed the Transactions with Sonnet, at which point the Company became a publicly listed entity on the Nasdaq Stock Market under the symbol "PURR."
